issues.explanation: The suite tests the non-2xx branch but never forces Http::post() to throw, so the catch/scrub path at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:37-41 and the requirement that the webhook URL never reaches the log are unverified.

The audit-channel test only calls Log::channel('audit')->info() and finishes with expect(true)->toBeTrue(), so it asserts nothing about the channel's path, level or retention and writes to the real log.
No test asserts the logging configuration contract (stack contains daily, daily/audit retention, absence of a discord channel), so those config requirements could regress silently.
The public send() method has no PHPDoc, while conventions.md:102 asks for PHPDoc on public methods touched.

review.summary: The change implements the full observability task: a container-resolvable DiscordOpsAlert with formatting, redaction and soft-fail, archive/audit logging config, env keys, ops documentation and a Pest test suite. The implementation meets the contract, but the transport-exception path (including URL scrubbing) has no test and the logging-channel test asserts nothing meaningful, which conflicts with the project's test-first rule, so the PR needs changes before merging.
